The '''Bahalian system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Astal sector/Legends|Astal sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and was home to the [[Bahalian Shipyards]].
